plan.title: Vendor revises after accepted counter offer

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with Vendor A at 100 and Vendor B at 90 on the Responses screen.
Enable counter offers on RFQs as required by the case.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Have the buyer send a 90 counter offer to Vendor A's own bid.
Verify that the buyer's counter offer was initiated for Vendor A.
Have Vendor A accept the buyer's counter offer in the vendor portal.
Verify on the buyer side that Vendor A's counter offer is marked accepted.
Have Vendor A attempt the requested revision to 88 using the same vendor identity.
Verify whether the revised bid was accepted by the vendor portal.
